question.text: Which of these statements is not true ?

options.text: LiAlH<sub>4</sub> is versatile reducing agent in organic synthesis.
Boron is always covalent in its compounds
In aqueous solution, the Tl<sup>+</sup> ion is much more stable than Tl (III)

solution.text:
(i) LiAlH4 is a versatile reducing agent
(ii) NO+ (14 electrons), O2(16 electrons) not isoelectronic
(iii) ​Tl+ is more stable due to Inert pair effect
(iv) Boron compounds are ionic as well 

B 2 O 3 + 2 NaOH → 2 NaBO 2 + H 2 O  
                                 (Sodium meta Borate)
